_meta.description: Real cost-of-living components per city, sourced from Numbeo (numbeo.com/cost-of-living). Values are in each city's LOCAL currency exactly as Numbeo reports them; USD is computed at apply time from assets/fx-usd.json. 'date' is Numbeo's 'data last updated'. numbeoSlug is the city segment in the Numbeo URL. Keyed by our city slug.
_meta.fields: cur, date, numbeoSlug, rent1c (1-bed centre), rent1o (1-bed outside), rent3c, rent3o, mealInexp, meal2mid, cappuccino, beer, transport (monthly pass), utilities, singleNoRent (single person monthly excl. rent), buySqm (buy price per m2 centre)
